name: Amazon Field
description: Provides an ASIN (Amazon product ID) field type with a widget, thirteen display formatters, and Views integration over the cached Amazon product tables.
project_description: Amazon Field is a submodule of Amazon PAAPI5 that adds an 'asin' field type storing an Amazon product ID (ASIN) per entity, with a text widget (asin_text) that validates the ASIN against the Amazon API/cache and a locale field setting. It ships thirteen field formatters (plaintext, product URL, detail, sales button, and small/medium/large thumbnails and galleries) that render the cached product via the parent module's theme layer, plus Views integration exposing the amazon_item / amazon_item_image / amazon_item_participant tables and a custom Amazon image field handler. Depends on amazon_pa for lookups, templates and Views base data.
